 Proshares Trust ( TQQQ ) posted a net outflow of $168.0 million in Friday's session, with gross ETF activity of $168.0 million all on the sell side. TQQQ bought nothing, increased no positions and reduced 71 holdings, against total assets of $32.08 billion.

 The largest sales were Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) at $16.6 million, Nvidia Corp. ( NVDA ) at $14.9 million, Microsoft Corp. ( MSFT ) at $13.1 million, Amazon.com Inc. ( AMZN ) at $9.3 million and Micron Technology Inc. ( MU ) at $7.1 million. None of the five was a new position or a full exit, and no buys were reported. 
 How does TQQQ invest? 
 Proshares Trust ( TQQQ ) is an Alternative Equity Leveraged fund with 3.0x leverage and an expense ratio of 0.94%. It holds 100 stocks, all large-cap, with 47.2% of assets in its 10 largest holdings; technology accounts for 55.4% of classified stocks, communication services 12.1% and consumer cyclical 11.8%. Top holdings include Apple at 8.59%, Nvidia at 7.73%, Microsoft at 6.77%, Amazon at 4.81% and Micron at 3.7%. It has a GF Score of 88, a P/E of 28.53, a P/B of 7.07, a dividend yield of 1.08% and a year-to-date return of 9.86%.
